info.title: BillToGreen API
info.description: Stateless backend for the BillToGreen mobile app. Every /v1 request needs the X-App-Token header.

get.description: Building outlines around a point, to suggest the roof on the solar map.

post.description: Sign a one-page carbon summary and return a public link to it (for a QR code).

distance_m.title: Distance M
distance_m.description: 0 when the requested point is inside the building.

source.title: Source
source.description: Where the outline comes from, e.g. OpenStreetMap or Google Open Buildings.

buildings.title: Buildings
buildings.description: The building containing the point first (smallest first), then the nearest.

ConfirmedBillInput.title: ConfirmedBillInput
ConfirmedBillInput.description: A bill the user has reviewed and confirmed on the device.

EnergySourceLine.title: EnergySourceLine
EnergySourceLine.description: Energy used from one source in the period (net calorific value for fuels).

ExtractedBill.title: ExtractedBill
ExtractedBill.description: Structured data read from a bill. All fields nullable except bill_type.

FactorInfo.title: FactorInfo
FactorInfo.description: Metadata of a configured constant, returned wherever it is used.

Inspection.title: Inspection
Inspection.description: A practical check for a flagged month. `code` lets the app localize; text is English.

om_fraction_of_capex_per_year.title: Om Fraction Of Capex Per Year

SolarWarning.title: SolarWarning
SolarWarning.description: Machine-readable note so the app can localize it; `message` is English.
